items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: So Sonny was getting -- he was drinking quite a bit at that time, so he got Butch Ballard as the extra drummer.

ctx.x: Oh, that must have -- that must have really given everybody a nosebleed, with Ernie Royal there.

Duke wasn't taking any chances, you see. He had been on that trip over there before and he wasn't taking no chances this time. So Sonny was getting -- he was drinking quite a bit at that time, so he got Butch Ballard as the extra drummer. And that whole trip Sonny hasn't got drunk yet 'cause he didn't want Butch up there playing his drums, you know, playing his gig, of overshadowing him. And it was

a beautiful trip.
That's when I started to playing the plunger. Tyree
didn't go either. So that's when I really starting to playing
the plunger and from then on I had Tricky Sam's chair.
